title: LinkDesk theme definition (ThemeRecipe)
description: Contract for the theme JSON file referenced by contributes.themes (modeled on plugin.schema.json; format errors are rejected on the spot). Mirrors the ThemeRecipe type in src/core/types/theme.ts; parsing semantics live in parseThemeRecipe. The new format requires colorways[] (the engine reads only the new format); appearance domains are sparse, and an omitted domain inherits the shell's :root default. Validated by scripts/check-theme-schema.mjs (part of the npm run check chain).

id.description: Theme id — globally unique (stored in app.theme; convention: the plugin's short name)

name.description: Theme display name — shown in the theme picker and the window title

type.description: Base light/dark mode — dark is the :root base, light is the data-theme override layer

appearance.description: Appearance domains (single value, sparse) — an omitted domain inherits the shell's :root default

radius.description: Eight radius steps (key = step name, value = px; 999 = full pill)

glass.description: Glass and floating panel material (ThemeSurface) — default: no glass, no floating

tint.description: Overlay tint color for the glass surface

opacity.description: Glass surface opacity (compositing baseline) — 1 = opaque / 0 = fully transparent, background shows through

specular.description: Liquid glass top highlight strength — 0 = off

specularColor.description: Base color of the top highlight — default: white; alpha still comes from specular

radius.description: Floating corner radius in px — 0 = square corners flush to the edge

shadow.description: Drop shadow lift — true = floating shadow (maps to --shadow-lift)

texture.description: Path to a tileable texture image asset (paper texture)

font.description: Font domain — a system font family name or a relative asset path (asset → @font-face → family name)

background.description: Image background domain (panorama = full window / zones = sliced)

image.description: Image path — the author provides a resolvable URL; the engine wraps it in url() when writing --bg-image

maskColor.description: Mask base color — default: black; alpha still comes from mask

mode.description: Slice mode — panorama (default) / zones (the same image sliced continuously)

colorways.description: Colorway list (multi-value color domain, at least one entry)

id.description: Colorway id — globally unique (stored in the dynamic app.themeColor enum)

colors.description: Color token set (key = contract token name without the -- prefix; value = a color string)
